in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Greek name Γεώργιος (Georgios), derived from the Greek words γεωργός (georgos) meaning ‘farmer, earthworker’. The name was borne by several saints in the early Christian period and is still a common name in the Greek-speaking world.
